purpose: faithnet's personal-agent SERVICE (spec 443 §1.1 / Ring 0 spec 442 §7.1) — the ONE client at every company's door for people of this estate: it presents with a service-scoped ClientKeyBindingV1 the Smart Agent signed, its JWKS and key directory are served at pap.faithnet.io, and each person is only a pairwise sub derived from her vault secret. Never a person's client_id. An operator note, not a persona.

service.description: Presents at companies' doors (Personal Agent Protocol, ACP, UCP, Visa TAP) for the people of faithnet. Holds no identity: one service-scoped client key binding, one JWKS; approval of any act is the person's mandate signature at her Home.

facets.description: Presents at companies' doors for the people of faithnet; the person is only a pairwise subject.
